Few places in the world can match the allure of Rarotonga. Whether you are planning a romantic getaway to Rarotonga for the first time or returning for more, there is always something new to discover.

## Most Romantic Spots

- Sunset viewpoints that offer breathtaking panoramas over Rarotonga
- Secluded beaches and hidden coves perfect for private moments
- Candlelit restaurants serving the finest local cuisine
- Scenic walks through charming neighborhoods and historic streets

## Romantic Activities

Cooking classes for two let you learn the secrets of Rarotonga's cuisine while bonding over delicious food.
